content:
alex: Dropping a compact draft for the launch blog hero + demo flow. Need fast checks: benchmark phrasing, CTA copy, and HubSpot form wiring. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/draft-compact.

marta: I'll do an editorial sweep. Suggest removing superlatives in the opener and calling out the eval run for any numeric claims.

sam: Benchmark suggestion: "On a mixed chat + long-context workload (avg conv ~700 tokens), Redwood reduced per-token compute by ~27% vs baseline (see run: run_2026_03_25_v3)." Will attach run CSV in a sec.

alex: Good. Kasia/legal will want the CSV or a conservative range.

kasia: Please attach the CSV link. If you keep a percent, prefer a range: "approximately 25-30%". Also include a short note on measurement methodology.

sam: CSV: s3://redwood-evals/2026/03/25/run_v3/metrics.csv. Methodology: mixed chat streaming, 1k token system prefix, 700 avg conv. Per-token compute normalized to baseline model run on same hardware.

jenni: Webinar: Wed 2026-04-07 08:00 PT. Capacity 200. Ops reserved 50 demo seats. Demand gen asks: enterprise-tagged leads get priority for first 36 hours, allocation 2 seats for enterprise, 1 for others. We need this spelled out.

oliver: Ops can implement that. Need HubSpot form id and a lead_tier property. Also will test webhook mapping tomorrow morning.

sam: HubSpot snippet to paste in Integration appendix: 
"hubspot_form_id: hs_100122"
"properties: email -> contact.email, company -> contact.company, lead_tier -> single_select (enterprise,startup,other), campaign -> product_launch_apr2026"

kasia: Draft CTA copy: "Register to see the launch and request a demo". Legal: confirm data processing lines: EU leads routed to EU HubSpot, retention 18 months (privacy to confirm).

legal-bot: auto-scan: only email/company collected. Please confirm Privacy for 18 months retention; if no response, default to 12 months.

marta: Editorial: under hero show a 3-step microflow: 1) Register 2) Confirm by email 3) Request demo (optional). Also move demo allocation rules to the FAQ.

alex: Approvals timeline: editorial + ops by Fri EOD, legal by Mon noon, publish Tue morning. Can people ack?

sam: Ack  will update benchmark sentence to use "approximately 25-30%" per Kasia.

jennI: Ack  will confirm webinar attendee counts and dry run schedule.

kasia: Ack  will chase Privacy and finalize claim sign-off.

oliver: Ack  will run webhook test tomorrow and paste test trace back here.

alex: Thanks all. I'll lock the draft after legal greenlights the claim language. :thumbsup:
